name: YouTube API Metadata
description: Provides YouTube metadata (title, description, thumbnails, channel info, stats) via the official YouTube Data API v3, without depending on yt-dlp. Requires Jellyfin 12.x; not compatible with Jellyfin 10.11.x or earlier.
overview: YouTube metadata provider using the official YouTube Data API v3

versions.changelog: Fix: Identify returned no results when a handle or name was typed into the "YouTube" ID field (it was sent to the API as a channel ID, which silently matched nothing). Both Identify fields now accept a channel ID, an @handle, a channel name, or a pasted YouTube URL; videos accept a video ID or any video URL. A handle or name saved in a series' YouTube external ID is resolved and replaced with the real channel ID on the next refresh.

Fix: the API key is now read on every call, so a key saved in the settings page works immediately instead of only after a restart (0.3.0.0 and earlier always used the key present at startup - empty on a fresh install - and every lookup failed with "No YouTube Data API v3 key configured"). Lookups are now logged (handle/name searches, hit counts, picked channel). Includes 0.3.0.0: channel-name and @handle search for series folders, title search for video files, full channel/video metadata (keywords, topics, country, banner images).

Channel-name search: series folders without a [channelId] are resolved by name or @handle (exact match preferred, result cached), and the Identify dialog returns full channel details. Video files without a [videoId] are matched by title within their channel. Series now get keywords as tags, topic categories as genres, country, home page URL, and the channel banner as backdrop/banner images; episodes get topic categories as genres. New settings to toggle the name/title lookups and the Identify result count.
Ported to Jellyfin 12.0 (net10.0, Jellyfin.Controller/Jellyfin.Data 12.0.0). Drops Jellyfin 10.11.x support.
